title: TightCut — resonant HPF, linked punch bell, listen-to-removed, routing
description:
Implement Tight Cut DSP: resonant high-pass with linked punch bell, listen-to-removed-low-end mode, and stereo/mid/side routing per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §6.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §6.1–6.3 (architecture, controls, punch linkage)
- Source/DSP/BiquadCoefficients.h/.cpp (HP cascade slopes, bell coeffs — read only)
- Source/DSP/TPTFilter.h/.cpp and Source/DSP/ParametricBand.* patterns for prepare/reset/process style (read only)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h tightCut_* IDs if present (read only; do not edit)

Implement Source/DSP/TightCut.h and Source/DSP/TightCut.cpp:
1. TightCut class with prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize), reset(), and process(float* const* channels, numChannels, numSamples) or equivalent juce::AudioBuffer view — no heap in process.
2. Signal path: Input → resonant HPF → linked punch bell → Output. Cutoff 25–220 Hz; slope 12/18/24/36 dB/oct via cascaded sections reused from BiquadCoefficients (or equivalent SOS state); HPF resonance Q 0.5–2.5.
3. Punch bell: f_p = r * f_c with r ∈ [0.75, 1.5]; punch gain 0 to +8 dB; punch Q 0.35–3.0. Linked mode moves punch with cutoff; unlinked allows independent punch frequency setter.
4. Pre/post placement flag is a data field only (processor owns final order); expose setPlacement/getPlacement for wiring without owning the graph.
5. Routing: stereo / mid / side channel masking only — no energy-normalized M/S encode/decode ownership here (apply on mid or side legs when route requests it using temporary mid/side if already a project pattern; otherwise document mid= (L+R)/2 style consistent with existing DSP).
6. Listen-to-removed-low-end mode: when enabled, output the content rejected by the HPF (dry − highpassed, or complementary LP path) so the user can audition removed lows; dry path must remain click-free when toggling.
7. Parameter setters/smoothers for cutoff, slope, resonance, punch ratio/freq, punch gain, punch Q, enable, listen, routing. Clamp to spec ranges. Coefficient updates must be zipper-safe (smooth freq/gain or crossfade).
8. Optional lightweight getters for GUI (cutoff, effective punch freq, enabled, listen active).

Do NOT edit PluginProcessor, CMakeLists.txt, ChugStabilizer, or tests.
acceptance_criteria: TightCut implements resonant HPF plus punch bell with f_p = r * f_c linkage and independent unlinked punch frequency
Slope supports 12, 18, 24, and 36 dB/oct; cutoff clamp 25–220 Hz; HPF Q 0.5–2.5; punch gain 0–+8 dB; punch Q 0.35–3.0
Listen-to-removed-low-end mode exposes the rejected low band instead of the filtered main path
Stereo/mid/side routing is channel-leg selection only without owning stage-level M/S encode redesign
No heap allocation in per-sample or per-block process paths
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/BiquadCoefficients.* or Source/DSP/TPTFilter.* beyond include/use
implement Chug Stabilizer or parametric Stage A

allowed: reuse BiquadCoefficients cascade builders for HPF slopes and RBJ bell for punch
float buffer API matching sibling DSP modules
DF1/TPT section state owned inside TightCut
placement as enum/data for processor fan-in
forbidden: GUI paint or APVTS layout ownership
